exclusion_sources.identity_normalization: uppercase Unicode NFKD ASCII transliteration followed by removal of every non-alphanumeric character
exclusion_sources.conservative_boundary: Any normalized identity appearing in either predecessor source is excluded even when its earlier response remained sealed.

source.published_scope: 631 late-type galaxies from 25 compilations; 356 have at least three optical photometry bands; the public landing page separately describes a 716-object expanded release.
source.source_reconciliation_rule: The acquired metadata row count and ZIP entry inventory control the concrete release receipt; no expected count is used to replace or cherry-pick identities.

prefreeze_audit.disclosure: The 4096-byte schema range also contained the first public metadata row, including mass summaries. No value from that row was used; the six atomic formulas and ensemble rule were copied only from the immutable attempt-1 receipt.

scientific_contract.hypothesis: The acceleration-occupancy interior-minus-exterior operator that converged in all five PROBES-I outer folds predicts untouched low-mass and low-surface-brightness PROBES-II rotation curves without selecting or refitting a candidate formula.
scientific_contract.zero_tuning_rule: Evaluate exactly the five attempt-1 fold cells, their frozen pointwise log-speed mean and median ensembles, and the exact earlier SPARC focusing cell. Select no cell, coefficient, operator, condition, ensemble weight, threshold, or gate from PROBES-II response values.
scientific_contract.primary_prediction: pointwise median log10 speed of the five attempt-1 fold-selected acceleration-occupancy cells
secondary_predictions: pointwise mean log10 speed of the five fold cells
each of the five fold cells separately
scientific_contract.baseline_boundary: The fixed stellar-only RAR is target-free. A frozen-architecture flexible local ridge is trained only out-of-fold inside PROBES II as a competitor and never changes the nonlocal predictions.
scientific_contract.advancement_boundary: A PASS is a replicated empirical nonlocal predictor, not a proof of modified gravity, a causal mechanism, historical novelty, or an alternative to GR.

measurement.photometry: Use only an r-band light profile. Prefer a release-labelled DESI r profile, then an SDSS r profile, with lexicographic tie-breaking fixed before any RC payload is opened.
measurement.distance: Use D (Mpc) from the allowlisted metadata table.
measurement.inclination: Derive from allowlisted q using cos^2(i)=clip((q^2-q0^2)/(1-q0^2),0,1); the published Incl column is retained only for a sensitivity report and never selects a formula.
measurement.stellar_mass: Use the same fixed r-band M/L=1 stellar-light conversion as attempt 1; do not read published gas, baryonic, stellar, dynamical, halo, density, or velocity summaries.
measurement.cumulative_light_rule: If the selected profile supplies a cumulative r-band magnitude, use it exactly as attempt 1. Otherwise convert r-band surface brightness to luminosity surface density and integrate concentric elliptical annuli using the allowlisted q and midpoint annular areas; enforce a finite nondecreasing cumulative profile. This fallback is frozen before any RC payload is opened.
measurement.surface_brightness_correction: Use the released r-band surface brightness as published because the PROBES-II metadata table supplies no allowlisted Galactic-extinction column; apply no target-derived or fitted offset.
measurement.rotation_radius_rule: Use angular radii as published; if and only if the radius header explicitly labels kpc, convert kpc to arcseconds using allowlisted D and the frozen angular conversion constant.
measurement.rotation_velocity_rule: Headers explicitly labelled line-of-sight are divided by sin(i); headers explicitly labelled rotation/circular/Vrot/Vc and an otherwise ambiguous column named only V are treated as already published deprojected rotation speeds. Report which rule each selected entry uses.
measurement.duplicate_rule: For each normalized physical identity, select the lexicographically first eligible r-profile/RC pair. Keep all other pairs sealed and report their count.
measurement.source_family_rule: Use the first path component below RotationCurves; if flat, use the filename prefix preceding the final object token; otherwise label UNKNOWN. This target-blind label is used only for counterexample strata.
measurement.formula_representation: Reuse attempt-1 stellar-light feature equations, nonlocal kernels, amplitude maps, and constants exactly.

evaluation.point_weighting: each selected physical identity contributes equal total weight
evaluation.primary_metric: equal-galaxy mean squared log10 speed error
